text:
The son was an intended donee beneficiary, but the owner and the landscaper changed the payee and the owner paid the landscaper before the son learned of the promise, assented, sued, or relied. Until one of those vesting events, the original parties may modify or discharge the duty, so that change left the son with no claim against the owner. The plaintiff will most likely not prevail; the answer is C.
CONFIDENCE: 90
